page_title: REI 0-2 AUX | Reims v Auxerre 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Romain Lissorgue blows the whistle, Paul Joly (Auxerre) is penalised for a foul.
90+3' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) takes a good first touch just outside the box and unloads a shot without any hesitation that bounces off the right post. Not a bad try.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ange Tia (Reims) comes onto the pitch for Valentin Atangana Edoa.
89' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
86' A substitution has been made. Sergio Akieme is replaced by Nhoa Sangui (Reims).
86' Here is a change. Gaetan Perrin is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre).
85' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
80' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) is being substituted because of an injury. Christophe Pelissier sends Paul Joly on the pitch.
77' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
77' Keito Nakamura (Reims) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
74' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) replacing Theo Bair.
74' Substitution. Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hamed Junior Traore walks off.
72' Junya Ito (Reims) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
67' Sergio Akieme (Reims) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
66' Samba Diawara has decided to substitute Oumar Diakite and he is replaced by Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims).
66' Substitution. Amadou Kone (Reims) has come on for John Joe Patrick Finn.
65' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
64' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
64' The resulting corner, taken by Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre), comes to nothing. Auxerre win a corner.
62' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

62' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
59' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
56' Keito Nakamura (Reims) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
55' Theo Bair (Auxerre) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Reims.
53' Keito Nakamura (Reims) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
50' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yehvann Diouf.
49' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) was too forceful with his tackle and Romain Lissorgue interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
47' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' Junya Ito (Reims) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Samba Diawara makes a half-time substitution. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) comes on in place of Teddy Teuma.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
44' The ball is cleared after Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Auxerre can continue in their attacking effort.
44' Theo Bair (Auxerre) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Yehvann Diouf to make a comfortable save.
43' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
43' Sergio Akieme (Reims) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Reims.
40' Junya Ito (Reims) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
40' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
39' The ball possession is 58:42.
34' A lofted cross from Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
33' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Romain Lissorgue no option but to blow his whistle.
31' The game has begun to heat up. Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
29' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) makes a rough challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
27' Theo Bair (Auxerre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Auxerre will take a corner kick.
26' The resulting set piece from Auxerre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
24' 0 - 2 Goal! Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
24' Theo Bair (Auxerre) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Yehvann Diouf makes a great save to stop his effort.
22' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

15' 0 - 1 Theo Bair (Auxerre) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Gaetan Perrin. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the right post behind the goalkeeper. It's 0:1.
15' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) is about to take a corner kick.
14' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
9' Keito Nakamura (Reims) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Auxerre work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

8' What a great chance for Kevin Danois (Auxerre). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. The ball is out of play and Auxerre manage to earn a corner.
8' The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
7' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Auxerre get a corner.
6' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
5' Reims take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

4' Junya Ito (Reims) latches on to a cross inside the box and heads the ball towards the right post, but it's an easy save for the keeper. The ball goes out of play and Reims have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Auxerre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

The players are out at last! Auxerre will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Romain Lissorgue.
